primitives.verbatim_quote: That processes in the visual apparatus propagate themselves laterally, if one may so express it, is also shown by the phenomena of contrast which occur after looking wpon wtions of various kinds.
primitives.assumptions: The visual system processes information through lateral interactions rather than strictly feedforward pathways.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when lateral interactions are disrupted by neurological damage or extreme stimulus.
